phase.name: Unify Artists and Comments Placeholders
phase.rationale: Core foundation for intelligent metadata parsing. Consolidate {artist}, {artist1}, {artist2}, {artists}, {featured} into single {artists} placeholder that supports multiple occurrences per pattern. Prevents ambiguous metadata capture.

task.changes: - Replace {artist1}, {artist2}, {featured} with {artists} - Allow multiple {artists} in single pattern - Examples: '{artists} & {artists} - {title}', '{artists} feat. {artists} - {title}' - Keep {artist} for single-artist patterns (backward compat)
- Add counter for multiple {artists} → artists_1, artists_2, etc. - Same for {comment} → comment_1, comment_2 - Generate named groups dynamically

task.description: Update FileNameParser.cs - TryPattern() to collect multiple groups
task.changes: - Extract all artists_N and comment_N groups from regex match - Combine into ParsedMetadata.Artists and ParsedMetadata.Comments - Remove duplicates (case-insensitive)
- Validate multiple Artists against DB - Keep existing db-check logic - No changes needed to final assignment (already handles array)

task.description: Test build and validate patterns work
task.changes: - Build project → must compile without errors - Load patterns from DB - Parse test filenames with multiple artists - Verify Mp3FileObject.Id3Artists populated correctly

phase.deliverables: - App compiles and runs - Patterns match multi-artist scenarios - ParsedMetadata.Artists contains all extracted artists - No data loss in existing functionality
phase.risks: - Regex complexity increases (mitigated by careful test cases) - Backward compat with old patterns (mitigation: test both old and new)

phase.name: Implement Disambiguation Dialog & Context-Aware Resolution
phase.rationale: Handle edge cases where extracted metadata is ambiguous (e.g., "Disturbed" as artist AND title). Album-aware resolution using existing DB relationships. User dialog for unresolvable cases.

task.description: Create DB tables: ArtistAlbums, AmbiguousMetadata, FeatureKeywords
Implement MetadataResolver service with confidence scoring
task.changes: - Layer 1: Album→Artist mapping (VeryHigh confidence) - Layer 2: DB frequency stats (High confidence) - Layer 3: Pattern context (Medium confidence) - Layer 4: Format heuristics (Low confidence)
- Call MetadataResolver.Resolve() for each extracted value - If Confidence < 70%, prompt user dialog (async) - Store user feedback in AmbiguousMetadata

phase.deliverables: - Dialog UI for ambiguous metadata - Confidence scoring system working - User feedback persistent in DB - Album-artist relationships tracked

phase.name: External API Integration (MusicBrainz, Spotify, Last.fm)
phase.rationale: Validate and enrich metadata using authoritative external sources. Implement cache layer to respect rate limits and support offline mode. Progressive enhancement (fallback to local DB).

task.changes: - IMetadataProvider interface - IMusicBrainzProvider, ISpotifyProvider, ILastFmProvider - Response/result DTOs

task.description: Create MetadataCache table and caching service
task.changes: - Cache responses with TTL (30 days default) - Avoid duplicate API calls - Support offline fallback
- Parallel provider queries (with timeout) - Confidence voting across providers - Rate limit respecting

task.description: Add "Verify Against API" UI button (optional auto-correct)
task.changes: - Manual verification flow - Auto-correct threshold (>90% confidence) - Show provider sources for transparency

phase.deliverables: - MetadataResolutionService working with MusicBrainz - Cache layer preventing duplicate API calls - Graceful fallback to local DB if APIs unavailable - User can verify metadata against APIs
phase.notes: - MusicBrainz: FREE, set User-Agent header properly - Spotify: requires OAuth setup (phase 3.6 later) - Last.fm: FREE with API key

phase.name: Audio Fingerprinting & Advanced Identification (Future)
phase.rationale: Future-proof: Handle remix identification, corrupted filenames, and Shazam-like functionality via audio fingerprints (Chromaprint) and AcousticBrainz.

task.description: Optional: ACRCloud integration for real-time Shazam-like lookup
Speech recognition for remix sample detection (ML-based)

importantNotes.note: Keep local DB as PRIMARY source of truth. External APIs are ENRICHMENT only. Always fallback gracefully if APIs unavailable.
After EACH phase, app must compile and run. Test with sample MP3 files to ensure no regression in existing functionality.
Phase 1 is foundation for everything else. Get it right, test thoroughly. Multiple {artists} in pattern is new concept → regex complexity increases.
Consider creating unit tests for FileNameParser regex patterns (especially Phase 1). Test cases: single artist, multi-artist, feat./vs./& variations, duplicates.
For Phase 3: Start with MusicBrainz only. Add Spotify/Last.fm in separate PRs to keep review scope manageable and allow incremental feedback.
